coverage.scope: This local operation only; no service health assessment

availability.reason: Requires an explicit private fleet store and, for new collection, a finite trusted inventory. Hosted grants are unavailable.

capability.description: Explicit finite inventory, pinned profiles and runner authority, durable child admission intents, bounded concurrency and no replay. Recovery only observes or cancels original child request IDs. The fixed error-budget consumer calculates supplied measurements; this is not live health assessment.
capability.title: Collect a frozen set of runner observations
